items.title: Nvidia’s Valuation Gap With AMD Just Got Bigger
items.summary: Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) dropped nearly 4% on July 29, its third sharp pullback in a week, and now trades well off its 52 week high. That sounds bad, but the sell off has pushed Nvidia’s valuation to its lowest since 2019, even as the company posted a record quarter. The gap between a cheaper stock and […]

items.title: Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Micron, Roblox, Reddit, SK Hynix, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: It’s looking like a positive end to a bad month as stocks rose Friday with the tech rebound continuing even as  Apple  decline weighed on the major indexes.  Amazon  gained 15% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.  Alphabet  and  Meta Platforms  were both punished by the market after hiking capex this earnings season.
